limits: Initial producer turn is complete and excludes correction input, tool calls and usage.
Correction phase is a snapshot until its task_complete event exists; rerun this script after completion for final correction costs.
Runtime usage counters are not an invoice. Input includes cached input; reasoning is already included in output and is not added twice.
Outer tool counts include wrappers and collaboration calls, not all nested calls.
Per-response usage sums are the phase metric; do not add runtime cumulative counters to them.
No active-labor timing, dollar cost or matched-arm saving is inferred.
source: Restored capture_telemetry.py run on the exact CODEX_THREAD_ID-matching log; phase counters separately partitioned by immutable turn_id. No unrelated conversation log read.
